user.title: Tesla Pulse Setup
user.description: Enter your Tesla Developer App credentials. You can create an app at [Tesla Developer Portal]({docs_url}).

vehicles.title: Select Vehicles
vehicles.description: Choose which vehicles to add to Home Assistant

key.title: Private Key
key.description: Generate a new key pair or import an existing private key. After setup, you must enroll the public key in the Tesla mobile app (Security → Vehicle Commands → Add Key).

error.no_vehicles: No vehicles found on this account
error.token_exchange_failed: Failed to exchange authorization code for tokens

abort.partner_account_not_registered: This Tesla Developer App is not registered for Fleet API access in your vehicle's region. Register the partner account with Tesla, including a public key hosted at your app's allowed-origin domain, then start setup again.

data.telemetry_inactivity_minutes: Minutes without telemetry before vehicle is asleep
data.wake_on_startup: Wake vehicle and refresh from API on startup

data_description.update_interval: Seconds between fallback vehicle-data requests. Short intervals can keep the vehicle awake and increase Fleet API traffic.
data_description.telemetry_hostname: Public DNS hostname for the Tesla Fleet Telemetry receiver. Leave blank until the telemetry add-on and public network route are ready.
data_description.telemetry_inactivity_minutes: After this interval without a vehicle telemetry frame, Tesla Pulse marks the vehicle as asleep. Commands wait for a new frame after wake-up before execution.
data_description.telemetry_port: Public TCP port for the Fleet Telemetry receiver.
data_description.wake_on_startup: When enabled, wakes each vehicle and refreshes its state through the Fleet API after Home Assistant starts. When disabled, the last cached telemetry state is restored and the vehicle remains asleep until telemetry arrives.
data_description.battery_reference_capacity_kwh: Original usable pack capacity in kWh. Leave blank to hide SOH while retaining capacity estimates.
data_description.battery_reference_capacity_preset: Optional approximate starting value by model. A value entered above always overrides the preset; presets are not authoritative.

battery.title: Battery health reference for {vehicle_name}
battery.description: Enter the usable battery capacity when new for {vehicle_name} ({vin}). Leave blank to disable the SOH percentage while still estimating current usable capacity.

data_description.battery_reference_capacity_kwh: The pack's original usable capacity in kWh, excluding inaccessible buffers. This is a user-provided reference, not nominal nameplate capacity.
data_description.battery_reference_capacity_preset: Optional approximate starting value by model. A value entered above always overrides the preset; presets are not authoritative.

options.model_y_lr: Model Y Long Range / Performance (~75 kWh)

pin.name: PIN
pin.description: 4-digit PIN for valet mode (required when enabling)

send_navigation.name: Send Navigation Destination
send_navigation.description: Send a destination to the vehicle navigation

reset_battery_history.name: Reset Battery Estimator History
reset_battery_history.description: Permanently discard selected accepted and rejected battery estimator windows for a vehicle.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: VIN of the vehicle whose estimator history will be reset.

scope.name: Evidence Source
scope.description: Choose all estimator evidence, only live telemetry windows, or only Recorder-imported windows.

rescan_capabilities.name: Rescan Vehicle Capabilities
rescan_capabilities.description: Clear Tesla Pulse optional-feature conclusions and begin a new telemetry observation run.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: VIN of the vehicle whose optional feature capabilities will be rescanned.
